Since you've come to me, the message must have arrived properly.
strings.이리스는 어디 있지? 어디로 데려간거야?: Where is Iris? Where did you take her?
She looked to be in danger, so I took her somewhere safe.
The mages of the Jewel school are containing her rampage in a secure place.
strings.이리스의 두려움이었던 마왕이 형상화되면서 약한 마음을 흔들었는데…. 그게: The Demon King, the embodiment of her fear, shook her fragile heart... And that has become troublesome. I never expected the source of darkness to get inside...
strings.원래는 내가 이걸 처리했어야 하는데, 최근에 루맨에 쓸데없는 일이 많이: I should have dealt with this myself, but so many unnecessary problems have cropped up in Lumen lately... Now that I say it aloud, it's all excuses.
Sigh... To think I'm explaining even this to you. That's how short-handed we are.
So I'd like you to lend a hand. This concerns Iris...
strings.그 일이란 거 내가 할 수 있는 거지?: This task... is it something I can do?
strings.이리스가 믿는 너라면 의외로 가능할지도 모르겠어. 키가 자라다만 꼬마랑: Since Iris trusts you, you might manage it unexpectedly well. Judging by how much that stunted kid and the spirit with the strange way of talking trust you...
Then go. If you can't resolve this, Iris and the others...
The worst thing you can imagine. Now, there's no time to stand around. When you're ready, reach toward the passage in front of me.
The kings inside will explain the rest. I'm counting on you.
strings.이런 곳에 인간분이 오시다니…. 혹시 여신님께서 말씀하셨던 분이신가요?: A human has come to a place like this... Are you perhaps the one the goddess spoke of?
strings.저 맞을 걸요. 그런데 여신님이면 세레스 님을 말하는 건가요?: I probably am. But by the goddess, do you mean Lady Seres?
Goddess Iris... I'm still not used to that.
Looking at you again, you must be the one who has endured such a difficult journey for Lady Iris.
strings.그나저나 여기는 어디지…? 벨로스와 정말 비슷하게 생겼네요: By the way, where is this...? It looks just like Belos.
strings.여긴 여신님의 심상세계 안이에요. 그중에서도 여신님께서 가장 소중히 여기: We're inside the goddess's inner world. This is the place she treasures most of all.
strings.벨로스 마을인가…? 그렇다면 충분히 이해가 가는군요. 저에게도 많은 추억: Belos Village...? That makes perfect sense. I have many memories of it too.
strings.울 때문에 이곳으로 오긴 했는데, 제가 뭘 하면 되는 거죠?: Ull sent me here, but what should I do?
I heard there's something that needs to be resolved inside...
I see. So Ull sent you...
It's both difficult and simple. Please help keep this place from collapsing.
strings.사람에게는 누구나 선과 악의 이면이 있다는 사실, 알고 계시죠?: You know that everyone has both good and evil within them, don't you?
I do. Iris's condition right now...
strings.신으로 태어난 자는 충분히 상관없는 이야기지만, 여신님은…, 이리스 님은: For someone born a god, that wouldn't pose much of a problem. But our goddess... Lady Iris is different.
strings.신이 만든 데르 족의 후손이라고 해도, 지금 이리스 님은 인간과 함께 오: Even as a descendant of the Der race created by a god, Lady Iris is still a human who has spent a long time living among humans.
She carries many feelings, experiences them, and acts upon them...
strings.그런 이리스 님의 공간을 파괴하고 무너뜨리려는 감정이 있어요. 바로 어디: One of those emotions seeks to destroy this place within her. It mixed with malice that came from somewhere else and took on a new form.
strings.일부지만 그런 이리스의 감정을 상대하면 되는 건가요?: So I need to confront those feelings of Iris's, even if they're only part of her?
Will that really be all right? What right do I have to interfere with Iris's feelings...?
You needn't worry so much about that.
strings.하르모니아가 그렇게 말씀하신다면 정말 괜찮은 거겠죠?: If you say so, Harmonia, then it really will be all right?
Yes, adventurer. Please go to Mir in the [Burning City].
Help Mir hold back the evil beings pouring into that place.
strings.메시지를 전달하고 돌아가면 될 줄 알았더니 오염된 녀석들이 상급자도 몰라: I thought I could deliver the message and go back, but the corrupted ones don't even recognize their superior and keep attacking me. If only Ull were here... Huh? This presence... Could it be?!
strings.아, 여기에요!! 울 님, 어서 오세요!! 여기 폭주하고 있는 정령들을: Ah, over here!! Ull, welcome!! Please use your sword aura on the spirits running wild... Huh?
Ull was busy, so I came in his place.
That's right. I've followed Iris's footsteps all the way from Belos...
Oh, you're that person. Then please help!
Wait. You'll need to explain a little more.
I'm sorry. If this place collapses, it's all over...
I'm sorry. I was being hasty.
strings.그럼 제가 여기서 어떻게 도와드리면 될까요? 어떤 정령이 아군인지, 적군: Then how can I help here? I can't tell which spirits are allies and which are enemies...
strings.지금 이곳에 있는 정령들은 모두 오염됐어요. 오염된 정령은 다른 정령들을: All the spirits here are corrupted. A corrupted spirit spreads that corruption to other spirits. I feel sorry for them, but Harmonia and Geis have already given their permission...
Hmm... Will you be all right, Mir? Even if the other spirits disappear...?
strings.어쩔 수 없죠. 정령들도 이해해줄 거예요. 세계를 위해서 일하는 아이들이: We have no choice. The spirits will understand too. If they serve the world, then surely...
strings.미르는 오염에서 괜찮은 건가요?: Are you safe from the corruption, Mir?
Yes. I'm different from ordinary spirits. I'm also a living being...
I'm glad nothing happened to you. There were more of them attacking than I expected...
I was fine. Thank you for worrying.
Still, thank you for doing even better than I'd hoped.
strings.이 사태를 못 막으면 이리스 안의 세계가 위험하다는거죠?: If we can't stop this, the world inside Iris will be in danger, right?
strings.맞아요. 이곳이 여신님의 심상세계라는 건 알고 계시죠? 이 세계는 여신님: That's right. You know this is the goddess's inner world, don't you? This world reflects her present condition.
The Burning City represents the destruction of civilization itself.
It means her evil emotions could take control of her body.
strings.제어권을 완전히 빼앗긴 여신님의 세계는 존재하지 않게 돼요. 점차 심상세: If control is completely taken away, the goddess's world will cease to exist. It may gradually spread beyond her inner world and into reality.
It hasn't happened yet, so don't be afraid.
strings.당신의 힘이 세레스 여신과 이리스 님의 축복이라는 걸 알고 있나요?: Do you know that your power is a blessing from the goddess Seres and Lady Iris?
strings.알고 계시다면 저기에서 오고 있는 오염된 정령들 좀 잡아주세요!!: If you do, please deal with those corrupted spirits coming this way!!
Be careful again, all right? There's still so much I need to tell you.
strings.생명을 위해 봉사하는 정령이기 때문에 누군가 다치는 모습은 보기 힘들어요: As a spirit who serves living things, it's hard for me to watch anyone get hurt.
strings.그나저나 방금 상대하셨던 녀석들에 대해선 어떻게 생각하시나요?: By the way, what did you think of the ones you just fought?
strings.이곳에 있는 정령하고 다른 것 같아요. 정령은 아닌 것 같고. 이상하게: They seemed different from the spirits here. I don't think they were spirits at all. They felt strangely unpleasant. Perhaps because their malice was so strong...?
You noticed correctly. They're the wicked servants of Evil Order.
Evil Order is a being born from the goddess's malice...
You could say it's a being made entirely of negative feelings toward this world.
Iris's dark, negative feelings took a form like that...
You and Lady Iris are going through so much...
Even if the path to saving her is long and hard, please keep going.
strings.두 상태의 이리스가 무너진다면 이리스도 괜찮아질까요?: If I defeat Iris in those two forms, will Iris herself be all right?
For the time being, she should be.
I'll try. I can do this...
Yes, I believe in you. The goddess believes in you too...
So you are the goddess's helper... I never expected to meet you in person.
It feels almost as though I were meeting Ull.
strings.울이라면 칭찬으로 하시는 말씀이시겠죠?: If you're comparing me to Ull, I assume you mean that as a compliment?
strings.정령은 악의를 담지 않네. 오염됐다면 모를까. 그대의 기운을 느낀 건 내: Spirits bear no malice, unless they have been corrupted. I could sense your aura simply because I am a Spirit King.
strings.정령왕? 아, 그럼 정령이시군요. 다른 정령들은 상태가 이상한데, 괜찮으: A Spirit King? Ah, so you're a spirit. The other spirits are in a strange state, but you seem all right.
strings.아아, 난 괜찮다. 여신께서 아이들을 돌보라 주신 힘이 내 목숨을 부지하: Yes, I am. The power the goddess gave me to care for the children is keeping me alive instead... I can only apologize to them and to her.
strings.그대가 와서 다행이다. 어둠의 근원 때문에 오염된 아이들과 악의들을 겨우: I'm glad you've come. I was barely holding back the children corrupted by the source of darkness and the beings of malice...
Harmonia and Mir... They too must be barely holding on.
strings.하르모니아는 알겠는데, 미르도 정령왕인가요?: I understand about Harmonia, but is Mir a Spirit King too?
Not a complete spirit, but a child with power comparable to a Spirit King's.
strings.어떻게 보면 우리보다 더 특별하지. 정령이면서 심상과 현실세계를 온전히: In some ways, Mir is more special than we are. Few spirits can move freely between the inner world and the real world...
strings.어쩌면 온전한 정령이 아니기에 악의의 맞서 싸울 수 있었던 걸지도 모른다: Perhaps it is precisely because Mir is not entirely a spirit that the child could resist the malice.
strings.어린 시절 정령의 도움으로 목숨을 건진 미르는 정령의 특성을 얻었는데,: As a child, Mir survived with a spirit's help and gained a spirit's traits. Mir considers that a blessing.
No, this is no time for such talk. I wish to place my faith in your strength and ask for your help.
strings.내가 본 그대의 힘과 재능, 그리고 의지라면 '저 세계'를 구할 수 있을: With the power, talent, and will I see in you, I believe you can save that world.
strings.\"혼돈의 협곡\"으로 가서 세상을 무너뜨리려는 악의 가득한 존재를 처치: Go to "Chaos Canyon" and defeat the being filled with malice that seeks to destroy this world.
The one you seek is there.
Remarkable. I'd heard of your abilities, but they exceed anything I imagined.
strings.여신님의 마음 일부가 형상화된 파편이라 해도, 그렇게 상대할 수 있을 줄: Even if it was only a fragment given form from part of the goddess's heart, I never thought you could face it like that.
I didn't know you were so strong.
strings.여신께서 불완전한 각성을 하신 만큼, 자네도 어딘가 불안한 곳이 있지 않: Since the goddess's awakening was incomplete, I worried that there might be some instability within you as well.
After seeing what you've done, I see no reason to worry.
strings.그대는 여신님을 위해 여기까지 왔다. 그리고 여신님이 믿는 자이기도 하다: You came all this way for the goddess, and you are someone she trusts. There is no need for further doubt.
strings.그러면 이제 뭘 하면 되는 거죠?: Then what should I do now?
There is something you must do. This time, go to the Frozen World.
Evil Order will be there, seeking to cover everything in malice.
A being that endlessly craves destruction and seeks to repeat it...
strings.여신님이 세상에 가지고 있는 애착만큼 큰 증오를 가지고 있는 또 다른 마: Another part of her heart, bearing hatred as great as the goddess's love for this world.
strings.반열에 오른 자라면 누구나 겪는 시련이라고도 할 수 있지만, 여신님은 그: You could call it a trial faced by anyone who ascends to divinity, but the goddess is suffering it with unusual intensity.
strings.아직 준비되지 않은 상황에서 맞이하는 시련이란 건 정말 가혹할 수 밖에…: To face a trial before one is ready is terribly cruel...
Even if she overcomes this difficult trial, she will face an even harsher fate.
But if you help her at her side... I believe she can overcome it.
strings.아, 벌써 간 건가…. 역시 행동만큼 여신님을 따를 수밖에 없는 운명이군: Ah, already gone... Your actions truly show that you are fated to follow the goddess. I leave her in your hands...
Aha! You really came. What a foolishly forgiving human. You're so entertaining.
strings.그렇게 이용당하면서도 계속 그 여자를 돕는 건 대체 무슨 생각이야? 정말: What are you thinking, helping that woman when she keeps using you like this? How laughable.
I might be funny, but I'm no laughingstock.
What's even more laughable is the idea of an evil being like you becoming the God of the Astral Realm.
strings.나약한 이리스, 악한 나. 어차피 둘 중에 누가 성계신이 되든 이 세계는: A weak Iris, an evil me. Whichever of us becomes the God of the Astral Realm, the world will end up a mess.
strings.어차피 엉망이 되는 세계, 내가 되면 어때서? 그러니 이쯤에서 돌아갔으면: If it's going to be a mess anyway, what's wrong with it being me? So I'd like you to turn back now. ♪
I can't leave things like this.
Hehe, how interesting. You, the being from the place Iris dreams of, are so interesting.
strings.왜 그 여자를 도와야 한다고 생각해?: Why do you think you have to help that woman?
strings.그냥 돕는 거로 보였다면 유감이야. 이제 내가 하는 일은 이제 이리스만을: If you think I'm simply helping her, you're mistaken. What I'm doing now isn't only for Iris anymore.
Playing the champion of justice too. Hehehe.
If you keep trying to hurt Iris, I won't forgive you.
strings.이리스 안에 있는 마음이 너처럼 변했다 하더라도 그건 이리스가 원한 게: Even if the feelings inside her changed into something like you, that can't be what she wanted.
strings.나는 악한 마음, 그 속에서 커져가는 존재. 당연한 사실을 부정하지 마라: I am an evil emotion, a being that grows within it. Don't deny the obvious!
strings.그만 해, 나는 그 말을 들으려고 온 게 아니야. 그러니까, 그러니까!!: Stop it. I didn't come here to listen to that. So... so!!
It's impressive that you've held your own against me this long. I'll give you that.
strings.벌써 그 소리를 몇 번째 하는 거야? 내가 널 쓰러뜨린 것만 해도 벌써: How many times have you said that already? I've defeated you four times now.
strings.말은 그렇게 해도 언제까지 버틸 수 있을까?: You say that, but how long can you keep going?
Fine. Let's find out. Let's see how long you can keep saying that.
Very well. I'll face you once more, you foolish human...
strings.잠깐, 이리스…? 이리스 맞아? 아, 이리스의 마음? 진짜는 밖에 있으니: Wait, Iris...? Is that you? Oh, Iris's heart? The real Iris is outside.
I was wondering where the weakest part of her heart had gone. So here you are.
Until now, the darkness hid my form and I couldn't do anything...
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 덕분에 이블오더와 싸울 힘이 생겼으니까요. 이제 제가 할: I'm all right. Thanks to you, I now have the strength to fight Evil Order. I'll take over, so please stand back.
All right. If that's what you want, Iris, I'll stand back.
strings.이블오더는 제 마음의 일부. 그렇기에 신에 버금가는 생명력과 힘을 가지고: Evil Order is part of my heart. That's why it has life force and power close to a god's.
strings.비록 상대하실수 있다 해도 완벽하게 소멸시킬 수는 없어요. 그래서 제가: Even if you can fight it, you can't destroy it completely. That's why I have to do it, here within my inner world...
strings.여기서 너희들 모두 소멸시키겠…, 크윽. 뭐지, 이 힘은?: I'll destroy all of you right here... Urgh! What is this power?
strings.(이리스와 이블오더 주위에 알 수 없는 힘의 장벽이 느껴진다.): (I sense a barrier of unfamiliar power around Iris and Evil Order.)
strings.나, 날 어디로 데려가는 거지? 그래봐야 이 안일텐데!!: W-where are you taking me? It'll still be somewhere inside here!!
strings.당신과 나는 이리스의 마음 중 일부. 마음만이 갈 수 있는 장소로 갈 거: You and I are parts of Iris's heart. We'll go somewhere only the heart can reach. Let's settle this there without hurting anyone else.
strings.심상세계 안은 괜찮아졌으니 정령왕들에게 알려주세요. 저라는 마음은 이블오: The inner world is safe now. Please tell the Spirit Kings. Though this part of me will probably have to fight Evil Order for quite a long time.
And let's meet again in my real body, %s...
strings.(나약한 마음의 이리스가 이블오더를 붙잡고 눈 앞에서 사라졌다.): (The fragile part of Iris's heart takes hold of Evil Order, and they disappear before my eyes.)
strings.인간의 선과 악은 항상 내면에서 싸우는 법. 인간으로 신에 오른 여신께서: Good and evil always struggle within the human heart. A goddess who ascended from humanity will have to face this process time and again.
You have done a great service. Thanks to you, the darkness is gradually receding from the inner world.
I did feel that things were slowly changing.
strings.그래, 이블오더가 조금 물러났으니 그런 기분이 느껴지는 거겠지. 그대는: Yes. Evil Order has retreated a little, so that must be what you feel. You are truly remarkable.
strings.혹시 이블오더가 또 심상세계에 나타난다면 어떻게 할 생각인가?: What will you do if Evil Order appears in the inner world again?
The spirits have stopped running wild, so we should be able to deal with the remaining darkness somehow.
As the Spirit King of Obedience and Covenants, I thank you on behalf of the many spirits.
You say you're all right, but something seems to be troubling you.
strings.두려운 게로군. 괜찮네. 이런 두려움은 인간이면 누구나 가지고 있는 것이: You're afraid. It's all right. Every human carries fears like these.
Then please tell Harmonia what has happened on your way back. I leave it to you.
strings.감사해요. 조화와 안정의 정령왕으로서 많은 정령을 대신해서 다시 한 번: Thank you. As the Spirit King of Harmony and Stability, I thank you once again on behalf of the many spirits.
strings.아이들의 상태만 봐도 좋아지는 게 보여요!: I can see the children are getting better just by looking at them!
If you're so grateful, give me something.
I have nothing I can give you right now, but I will grant you the goddess's blessing.
Hehe. I can't tell you yet.
You're a spirit with a lot of secrets.
strings.사람들도 그렇듯이 정령들에게도 비밀 한두개 쯤은 있답니다. 죄송해요, 농: Just like people, spirits have a secret or two. Sorry, that was a joke. It wasn't very funny, was it?
The goddess will be all right. She isn't whole yet, but...
If she rests, endures her trials, and overcomes them, she will become a true god.
strings.그때까지 여신님을 도와주세요. 모두 모험가님이라면 믿을 수 있다고 그러니: Please help her until then. Everyone says you are someone we can trust.
Yes. I want to believe in her and help her too.
strings.그럼 나중에 또 만나요. 처음 발을 내디딘 곳에 계시면 다시 원래의 자리: Then let's meet again sometime. If you return to the place where you first arrived, you should be able to go back.
strings.심상세계에서 돌아 오셨군요. 그곳에 들어갔어도 좀처럼 돌아오는 이는 없었: You've returned from the inner world. Few who enter that place manage to come back...
...So it was that kind of place. Still, I was all right. Everything ended well.
Ull looked busy, so I came to ask you about Iris's condition, Yuran.
strings.비교적 괜찮아요. 폭주하던 모습을 멈추고,숙면을 취하고 계십니다. 그러면: She's relatively well. Her rampage has stopped, and she's sleeping deeply. Could you tell me what happened in there?
strings.(이리스의 심상세계에 있었던 일을 유란에게 설명한다.): (I explain to Yuran what happened in Iris's inner world.)
strings.흐음…. 안 그래도 제가 고민을 좀 해봤습니다. 스승님께서도 부탁하신 부: Hmm... I've been giving this some thought. My master asked me to consider it as well...
I think Lady Iris's complete awakening will take some time.
strings.많은 적이 노리고 있고, 아직 두려워하시는 것이 있는 이상, 시간이 걸릴: With so many enemies targeting her, and things she still fears, it will take time.
Let me explain the conclusions I've reached.
I've looked into every way we might help Lady Iris become a more steadfast god.
Among them, there is one approach that seems possible...
It sounds as though that will be my job.
Yes, that's right. Then I'll explain. What we need to do is...
